o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *boguday.
Cognate with Turkish buğday, Bashkir бойҙай (buyðay), Kazakh бидай (bıyday), Kyrgyz буудай (buuday), Southern Altai буудай (buuday), Turkmen bugdaý, Uzbek bugʻdoy, Chuvash пӑри (pări, “farro”).

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طالو (ṭalu), from Middle Mongol ᠳᠠᠯᠤ (tʾlw /⁠dalu⁠/). Cognate with Chagatai دالو (dʾlw /⁠dalu⁠/), dialectal Turkish dal (“back; arm; shoulder”), Kyrgyz далы (dalı, “shoulder blade”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طال (dal), from Proto-Common Turkic *tāl.
From qır + -ıcı. Likely a calque of Russian истреби́тель (istrebítelʹ).
